latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of the skill "change-effect-analysis" for software engineers working with legacy code.
- Provides a systematic process to identify the ripple effects ("blast radius") of a proposed code change.
- Produces a focused test placement plan by identifying high-leverage test "pinch points."
- Supports use cases where changes affect multiple classes or have complex propagation.
- Designed to be language-agnostic and useful even where existing tests are missing.
- Requires identification of the change point, change description, and access to the codebase.
